description: Resolve QIDs or PIDs to their human-readable labels and descriptions, with no claim data. Resolves up to 500 distinct IDs per call, batched automatically; distinct IDs past the first 500 come back in deferredIds to send in a follow-up call. Accepts bare IDs (Q76), entity URIs (http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q76), and wd:Q76 — the forms wikidata_sparql_query returns — so its results can be humanized as they are.

ids.description: Q-IDs (e.g., "Q76") or P-IDs (e.g., "P31") to resolve, bare or as an entity URI or wd: form (e.g., "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q76", "wd:Q76"). Up to 10,000 entries; duplicates count once, the first 500 distinct IDs resolve, and the rest come back in deferredIds. A malformed entry is returned in invalid without failing the call.

languages.description: Wikidata language codes for returned labels and descriptions (e.g., ["en", "de", "fr"]), up to 50. Case-insensitive; "_" is read as "-"; blank entries are dropped, and an empty list means ["en"]. A language with no label of its own falls back to the entity's multilingual ("mul") value, returned under the requested code.

name: wikidata_get_labels

deferredIds.description: Distinct IDs past the first 500, in input order, not looked up in this call — send them in another call. Absent when every ID fit.

descriptions.description: Map of language code to description string. Keys match the requested languages that have data.

labels.description: Map of language code to label string. Keys match the requested languages that have data.

entities.description: Map of entity ID to labels and descriptions. IDs that were not found are absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_ids`: No entry in the array is a Q-ID or P-ID, bare or as an entity URI or wd: form. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Count of IDs that returned data.

invalid.description: Entries that are not a Q-ID or P-ID in any accepted form, echoed as sent and never looked up. Absent when every entry is well-formed.

languages.description: The language codes that were requested.

notFound.description: Well-formed IDs that were looked up and returned no entity (unassigned or out of range), each once.

notice.description: Present when IDs were deferred: how many resolved, and how many to send again from deferredIds.

title: Get Wikidata Labels
